recordSchema.name: sensorOrientationPtz
recordSchema.label: Sensor Orientation
recordSchema.description: Real-time orientation of the camera sensor computed from the current PTZ position. Heading and pitch are derived by applying pan and tilt offsets to the platform mount orientation. Updated each time the PTZ output polls the camera.

fields.name: orientation
fields.description: Euler angles with order of rotation heading/pitch/roll in rotating frame

coordinates.name: heading
coordinates.label: Heading Angle
coordinates.description: Heading angle from true north, measured clockwise

coordinates.name: pitch
coordinates.label: Pitch Angle
coordinates.description: Rotation around the lateral axis, up/down from the local horizontal plane (positive when pointing up)
